title: Purchase experience, layout, and shaking mentions
summary: This topic mixes purchase-experience praise and criticism with unrelated mentions of interior layout, charging delays, family space, app convenience, seat cooling, and vehicle shaking, so the sample does not form a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the buying process, dealership support, and interior layout.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the overall experience as so bad that the owner wants to sell the vehicle.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews report a poor purchase experience and inability to recommend both the dealer and the vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention long charging processes, shaking during restart or control handoff, seat cooling, app family-use convenience, cabin setup, and family room without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several unrelated subjects rather than one clear theme.
